content.overview: Section 13 regulates alteration of the memorandum of association: change of name, change of objects, and change of the State of the registered office. Alteration generally requires a special resolution, prescribed approvals where applicable, and filing of the altered memorandum with the Registrar.
content.glance: State the special-resolution requirement; list name, objects and State-of-office alterations; note Central Government / Regional Director approval routes and filing.
content.study: The memorandum may be altered only in the manner provided in the Act. Section 13 covers (a) change of name (with Central Government approval where required, and subject to name-availability rules), (b) alteration of objects, and (c) change of the registered-office State (special resolution and Regional Director approval in the prescribed cases). The company must file the altered memorandum and comply with notice and registration requirements. Until the Registrar registers the alteration, it does not take full effect for certain purposes. Current-law framing: ground the analysis in s. 13 and link to s. 4 (contents of memorandum) and s. 12 (registered office).

sections.heading: Change of Name
sections.body: Name may be changed by special resolution and, where required, Central Government approval; the new name must comply with name rules.

sections.heading: Alteration of Objects
sections.body: Objects may be altered by special resolution; the altered memorandum must be filed with the Registrar.

sections.heading: Change of Registered-Office State
sections.body: Shifting the registered office from one State to another requires special resolution and Regional Director approval as prescribed, with filing of the altered memorandum.

sections.heading: Filing and Effect
sections.body: The altered memorandum must be filed; registration by the Registrar is required for the alteration to take full effect.

examples.title: Object change
examples.body: A company passes a special resolution to expand its objects and files the altered memorandum under s. 13. On registration, the alteration is effective.

examples.title: State shift without RD approval
examples.body: A company shifts its registered office to another State without obtaining the prescribed Regional Director approval. The alteration is incomplete under s. 13.

hypotheticals.question: Can the memorandum be altered by ordinary resolution?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 13 requires a special resolution for the alterations it covers, plus prescribed approvals where applicable.

hypotheticals.question: When does a name change take effect?
hypotheticals.analysis: After compliance with the special resolution, any required Central Government approval, and registration of the altered memorandum by the Registrar.

distinctions.title: Alteration of memorandum (s. 13) vs articles (s. 14)
distinctions.left: Charter: name, objects, State of office

rows.right: Special resolution subject to Act and memo

misconceptions.trap: Any board resolution can alter the memorandum.
misconceptions.correction: Section 13 requires a special resolution of the company and prescribed approvals.

misconceptions.trap: Filing alone completes a State change of registered office.
misconceptions.correction: Regional Director approval is required in the prescribed cases before the shift is effective.

cases.name: Salomon v. A. Salomon & Co. Ltd.
cases.facts: Properly incorporated company challenged as indistinct from controller.
cases.ratioDecidendi: Registered company is a separate legal person.
cases.relevance: Already in file; the memorandum defines the person created on registration.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 13 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the type of alteration (name / objects / State). II. State special resolution and approval requirements. III. Check filing and registration. IV. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Type of alteration; resolution; approvals; filing status; precise relief.

examTips: Map the alteration type to the correct approval route.
Note filing and registration for effect.
